title: Semantic Pack L1_103 — mixed_review_3
description: A corrected multilingual Progressive Language pack for Mixed Review 3.

sourceTopic.title: 103 — Mixed Review 3
sentenceGoals: What can you do at the station?
What can you do in the park?

analysis.literalOrderExplanation: What
Was
grammarExplanation: German question words often trigger verb-second order.

analysis.literalOrderExplanation: Qu'est-ce que c'est
grammarExplanation: French question words can start a sentence.

analysis.literalOrderExplanation: ¿Qué
grammarExplanation: Spanish question words carry an accent.

analysis.literalOrderExplanation: 什麼
grammarExplanation: Chinese question words stay in the same position as the answer.

analysis.literalOrderExplanation: 何
grammarExplanation: Japanese question words take particles like が or を.

en.text: What can you do at the station?

analysis.literalOrderExplanation: What → can → you → do → at → the → station?
grammarExplanation: English word order: question word + auxiliary + subject + main verb.

de.text: Was kann man am Bahnhof machen?

analysis.literalOrderExplanation: Was → kann → man → am → Bahnhof → machen?
grammarExplanation: German verb-second order in questions.
Question word + verb + subject + rest.

fr.text: Qu'est-ce qu'on peut faire à la gare?

analysis.literalOrderExplanation: Qu'est-ce → qu'on → peut → faire → à → la → gare?
grammarExplanation: French questions: question word + verb + subject + complement.
Inversion may be used in formal French.

es.text: ¿Qué se puede hacer en la estación?

analysis.literalOrderExplanation: ¿Qué → se → puede → hacer → en → la → estación?
grammarExplanation: Spanish questions: question word + verb + subject.
Question words carry a written accent.

analysis.literalOrderExplanation: 你在 → 車站 → 可以 → 做什麼？
grammarExplanation: Chinese word order stays the same in questions.
Question words replace the information being asked about.

analysis.literalOrderExplanation: 駅 → で → 何 → が → できますか？
grammarExplanation: Japanese keeps the verb at the end in questions.
The か particle marks a question.
